title: Errors in a Jazz Life photo caption: Monk Hazel and Bix-styled trumpeter
summary: Sal says a published band caption wrongly listed Monk Hazel on drums when Lee Wilder played, and mentions a Bix-like trumpeter and Armand Hug.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: You know one time, excuse me, in a jazz club, a jazz club, when the book was put out, there's a picture in there and it gives the names of the fellas in the band. And it says, on drums, Monk Hazel. Monk was nowhere near the place. Monk didn't play drums in his band. Lee Wilder played drums because I got ahead of the jazz myself. Went to the sky to the mountain in New York. Fred Norman on the piano. Bill Hillen playing trumpet. He kind of played like Bixson those days, Bill Hillen. I never met him.
I know you've heard of him.
Allman used to play with him. That's right. Well, I was playing in the band, see. At the point, allman played piano and Billy played trumpet.
Just like Bix, man. And here they went to New York and lay on drums. Not Monk Hazel. I said, drum, Monk. He was nowhere near that.
Tell him how long you know Arm and Hope.
I got a picture of him. I used to play ball. I was kids, man. Allman.
